claim_boundary: paired scale-normalized frozen-probe measurement only; no causal, routing, utility, learning, adaptation, calibrated-belief, or general capability claim without manual review

conditions.delay_plus_two: same six evidence plus D+2 delay
conditions.neutral_cue_plus_two: same six evidence plus each reliability-0.5 two-symbol suffix plus D delay

primary_target: six-event public-evidence log_odds, identical across paired variants
primary_transform: divide each complete full-state vector by its own pre-resolution global L2 norm before fixed projection; no condition-wide, corpus-wide, or label-dependent statistics
fit_scope: fit coefficients and feature standardization on transformed train-family base rows only; apply the exact frozen probe to heldout A/B/C rows
independent_unit: model seed; neutral suffixes and projection settings are dependent sensitivity conditions
acceptance_criterion: for every seed, B, every C suffix, and every fixed projection sensitivity, L2-normalized projected state exceeds every matched control; this supports only scale-normalized transfer
falsifier: any B or C failure under the fixed L2 transform; no causal channel intervention follows failure
